notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
So thanks to some of my players. I noticed that there seemed to strange issues with the game not properly loading the basement stairs and the lighting was all kinds of off. So I went ahead and attempted to address those issues.

I'll keep my eyes out for any more issues.
Also if you notice any issues don't hesitate to contact me!
